features: Analog Turbo HD ColorVu Audio turret — 4-in-1 (TVI/AHD/CVI/CVBS) switchable output over coax; NOT an IP camera
Up to 20 m white supplement light with smart supplement light
Built-in mic with audio over coaxial cable
release_notes: The Hikvision DS-2CE70DF0T-MFS is an analog Turbo HD 2MP ColorVu audio turret with 24/7 full-color imaging (F1.0), up to 20 m white supplement light, built-in mic and 4-in-1 TVI/AHD/CVI/CVBS output over coax in a metal IP67 housing. Verified against the official Hikvision datasheet (Datasheet-of-DS-2CE70DF0T-MFS_20220721.pdf).
